spriteCalls.note: QA observes synchronous CPU call wall time of existing ProductionArt.drawFrame and Canvas calls on the supplied renderer context only. drawFrame, Canvas methods and accessors are inclusive observations; nested calls overlap and must not be added as exclusive costs. Observer hooks, clocks and primitive snapshots add overhead. Hooks detach at every endFrame and reinstall at the next beginFrame, adding per-frame property installation overhead and avoiding retired inner-observer wrappers when owners change. No extra draw, render, pixel read, bitmap, upload or asset operation is performed. Reports retain at most 80 frames and 32 primitive outliers; these bounds are not a peak-memory measurement. Source labels describe the selected sprite, not unique actors or renderer categories. No GPU execution time, FPS, performance improvement or cold-decode conclusion is implied. With an independent observer wrapping the same art, begin that observer first, end this observer first, and stop this observer first.

note: Saved browser JSON only; no Game, browser, Canvas, clocks or storage are invoked. A(off)/B(on) is an instrumentation-overhead/control observation, not a product optimization or FPS/GPU/memory result. Frame/raw-delta and nested CPU call wall timings are callback distributions; nested stages overlap and must not be summed. A per-callback mean call duration is not a per-call percentile, and retained top32 outliers cannot reconstruct the full call-duration distribution. drawFrame minus drawImage is only an arithmetic inclusive-call diagnostic, including wrapper/clock overhead and other work, not exclusive geometry time. Actual rAF schedules, focus, catch-up ticks and events can differ across passes; cross-pass HP/RNG equality is not a valid oracle. memoryOnly in JSON records the app decision but does not itself prove genuine storage branding; that source gate and browser origin require separate verification.
